scope: Colored reference paints in Tamiya acrylic X/XF, enamel X/XF, LP, TS, AS and PS catalogs, including PS special item 69944. Not a catalog of primers, paint markers, panel liners, weathering products or clear coating agents.
legacyOnlyReason: These three pre-existing enamel records are absent from both current Japanese and English official enamel catalogs. Keep their identity and RGB to load old recipes; exclude from new search results. Acrylic versions remain available.
samplingMethod: ICC-enabled MuPDF 1.28.2, official 202405 PDF page 2, 6x6 pt region inside the exact labeled chip rendered at 4x to sRGB, per-channel median. PS 46/47 are angle-dependent effects: one chart sample is only a color reference. The 202605 PDF search result returned HTTP 404 on both official hostnames, so it was not used.
